question: An amount of ₹785 is divided among three persons in the ratio of 19 : 3 : 18. The difference between the largest and the smallest shares (in ₹) in the distribution is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Ratio parts = 19 + 3 + 18 = 40 units.

Difference between Largest (19) and Smallest (3) = 16 units.

Required difference = (16 ÷ 40) × 785 = (2 ÷ 5) × 785.

Required difference = 2 × 157 = 314.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹314.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff81379fc379dec3a081f134c1835cc70d84a26e1613d561ef782fa3b098740b.png] 

**Given:**

Total amount = ₹785

Ratio of shares = 19 : 3 : 18

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of ratio terms = 19 + 3 + 18 = 40

⇒ Value of 1 unit = 785 ÷ 40 = ₹19.625

⇒ Largest share = 19 units

⇒ Smallest share = 3 units

⇒ Difference = 19 − 3 = 16 units

⇒ Required difference in ₹ = 16 × 19.625

⇒ Required difference = ₹314

**∴ The correct answer is ₹314.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

If a total quantity T is divided in the ratio a : b : c, then the share of the first person is (a ÷ (a+b+c)) × T.

Difference between shares

The difference between any two shares can be calculated directly by using the difference of their respective ratio units: Difference = ((a − b) ÷ (a+b+c)) × T.
